steps.headline: Sound popup: which small section labels look best?
steps.notice: Look at: VOLUME and NOTIFICATION above each group. Only the small labels change.

variants.label: Small capitals
variants.summary: One style of small grey capitals everywhere (10px). Marketplace's bigger, darker capitals shrink to match.

variants.label: No capitals
variants.summary: The same labels in normal case: small grey 12px text, no spaced-out capitals.

steps.risk: This settles the smallest heading level. The larger ones are already set: popup titles (16px bold, you chose) and big groups on full screens (18px, like Destin's picks).
